description:
# 🚫 THIS IS **NOT** BannerHub v6

This is a **bare GameHub 6.1.0 patched build** carrying **only the PC-engine signature bypass** (plus file access + privacy strips). **It is NOT the BannerHub v6 app** — none of BannerHub's features (login bypass, BannerHub catalog, Explore, Banner Tools, GOG, in-game Steam chat, per-game menus, …) are in here. It still uses **XiaoJi's own login and API**.

👉 **For BannerHub v6, install [v1.0.0-609](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/releases/tag/v1.0.0-609)** (the current Latest). This release exists purely to test GameHub 6.1.0 PC-game launching on a re-signed build.

---

## ⚠️ Experimental milestone build — read before installing

These are per-variant **GameHub 6.1.0** patched builds (PuBG, Ludashi, AnTuTu, Genshin, …). They solve **one** thing: getting GameHub 6.1.0's new **downloadable PC-engine plugin** to load on a re-signed build.

**This is not a replacement for the current stable ([v1.0.0-609](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/releases/tag/v1.0.0-609)).** The rest of the BannerHub patch set has **not** been re-derived for 6.1.0 yet, so this build still uses **XiaoJi's own login and API**. Install it only to test 6.1.0 PC-game launching. For the full BannerHub experience, stay on 609.

---

## Why the old recipe stopped working on 6.1.0

Through GameHub **6.0.9**, making a variant was simple: **rename the package** (so multiple spoofed copies install side-by-side) and **re-sign the APK with our own key**. The entire emulator shipped *inside* the APK, so a renamed, re-signed GameHub just ran.

**6.1.0 changed the architecture.** XiaoJi pulled the whole PC emulator — Wine, the X server, the virtual filesystem, GPU info (~6.7 MB of native code, ~200 classes) — **out of the APK**. It's now a separate **~22 MB plugin APK** that GameHub **downloads on first PC-game launch** and loads dynamically (through a DexClassLoader framework XiaoJi calls **"ComboLite"**) into a dedicated `:pcengine` process.

Here's the catch that breaks the old recipe:

> **The plugin loader requires the downloaded plugin's signing certificate to *exactly match* the host app's signing certificate.**

- On a **stock** install the host GameHub and the downloaded plugin are **both signed by XiaoJi** → certificates match → the plugin loads.
- The moment you **re-sign the host** with any other key — our BannerHub key, a test key, anything — the host's certificate no longer matches the plugin, which is still signed by **XiaoJi** and which **we cannot re-sign** (we don't have XiaoJi's private key).

So on 6.1.0 the old "rename + test-key sign" build **installs and opens fine, but cannot run a single PC game.** Every launch downloads the genuine plugin, then rejects it for a signature mismatch, and the emulator never loads. **Simply changing the package name and signing with a test key is no longer enough** — the signature relationship between host and plugin has to be dealt with in the host's code.

---

## What these builds bypass (three signature gates)

The fix is to stop the (re-signed) host from *demanding* that the plugin match its signature. There turned out to be **three independent checks**, all patched here. Every patch is in the **host only** — we never touch, repackage, or redistribute the plugin; GameHub still downloads XiaoJi's **genuine, unmodified** plugin from XiaoJi's own servers, and we only stop the host from rejecting it:

1. **Framework validation strategy.** ComboLite has a configurable policy (`Insecure` / `Strict` / `UserGrant`); GameHub ships `Strict`. We force it to **`Insecure`** — the framework's own built-in "skip signature check" mode.
2. **PC-engine manager check.** A separate certificate comparison in GameHub's own plugin manager that rejects with *"plugin signature does not match host."* We make it report a match.
3. **Install-time validator (the decisive one).** A **hard-coded** signature check deep inside ComboLite's installer that runs when the plugin is committed in the `:pcengine` process, throwing *"Plugin signatures do not exactly match host signatures."* It **ignores** the validation-strategy setting above, so it has to be neutralized on its own. We make its validator a no-op.

With all three patched, a re-signed BannerHub host downloads the genuine plugin and loads it — **device-confirmed: PC emulation launches on GameHub 6.1.0.**

---

## What works / what doesn't (please read — this is NOT the full 609 feature set)

**This build is essentially stock GameHub 6.1.0 + the signature bypass + a handful of patches that survived the base bump. Most of BannerHub's functional features have NOT carried over from 609 yet** — 6.1.0 reshuffled the app's bytecode, and every patch that hooks into the app's logic needs re-deriving before it works again. What did carry over are the manifest/resource-level patches, which don't depend on that bytecode.

**Working in this build:**
- ✅ **PC-engine plugin installs and PC games launch** (the whole point of this release)
- ✅ Per-variant package rename + coexistence, our stable signing key
- ✅ File-manager / storage access, external-launcher support
- ✅ Privacy strips (Firebase, GMS Measurement, Mob Push, Aliyun NumberAuth, Ad-ID)

**NOT working yet (not re-derived for 6.1.0):**
- ❌ **Login bypass** — this build still logs into **XiaoJi's** account/API (`api-international-gamehub.xiaoji.com`)
- ❌ **BannerHub catalog redirect / `/v6`** — still uses XiaoJi's backend, not the BannerHub Worker
- ❌ **Explore** tab hijack, **Banner Tools** menu, **GOG**, **in-game Steam chat/voice overlay**, **offline component picker**, **per-game settings menus** (GPU spoof / vibration / show-PC-settings), **stub analytics**, heartbeat/in-game overlays

> Heads-up: some of those features' *screens and assets* are technically present in the APK (the manifest/resource half of the patch applied), but the bytecode that **wires them into the UI failed**, so there is **no way to reach them** — treat them as absent, not usable.

**Bottom line:** install this only to test 6.1.0 PC-game launching. For the complete, working BannerHub feature set, stay on **v1.0.0-609**. Full 6.1.0 parity is the next chunk of work (the usual per-base-bump fingerprint re-derivation).

---

## Variants

Each APK is a distinct package so several can be installed at once. All signed with the BannerHub test keystore (same key as the 609 line).

| Variant | Package |
|---|---|
| Normal | `banner.hub` |
| Original | `com.xiaoji.egggame` |
| PuBG | `com.tencent.ig` |
| PuBG-CrossFire | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` |
| AnTuTu | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` |
| alt-AnTuTu | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` |
| Ludashi | `com.ludashi.aibench` |
| Genshin | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` |
| Normal-GHL | `gamehub.lite` |

Base: **XiaoJi GameHub 6.1.0** (versionCode 122). We do not distribute XiaoJi's app or the plugin; these are patch-diffs applied to a base you supply/own.
